stem: A grow tent physically fits six plants, but the room has limited dehumidification and only a small drying area. What is the strongest planning decision?
choices: Reduce crop scope to match environmental and post-harvest capacity
Use six plants because physical fit is the only capacity limit
Add more plants and reduce observation time
Assume drying capacity can be improvised later
rationale: Crop scope should match the full system capacity, including environmental control, access, and post-harvest handling.
